title: Is it possible to make multiple windows interact with each other in RPG Makr MZ ?

posts.author: Zhyren
posts.body:
I saw a gif by geegaz and it gave me some inspiration.
The Inspiration
View attachment 324755
I found out this was made with godot but I'm wondering if something similar can be done in RPGMaker MZ?
My idea was mainly to have two windows opened and the player would put the two windows together to create a bridge the sprite would have to cross in order to proceed to the next level.
If something like this can't be done directly or can't present the illusion that there are actually two windows opened, I'm opened to other meta ideas or alternatives. Thank you for reading and sorry for the possibly inane question.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from RPG Maker MZ Tutorials to RPG Maker MZ Support.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Possible? Yes, e.g. a plugin might achieve that kind of thing using multiplayer-like mechanics.
Easy? Almost certainly not.
